question_matched_verdict: Discrepancy explained: a replayed request creates a second record; mapped to DEFECT_PROVEN.
disposition_detail: Use the persisted request identifier before inserting a second record.
mechanism: The replay path inserts a new record before checking the existing request identifier. Two submissions with the same identifier create two records.

evidence.claim: Two identical request identifiers create two records in the dated test database.
The insert precedes the existing-request check in ExampleReplayRequest.
The ticket requires repeated submissions of one identifier to preserve the original order.

unknowns: Current production impact has not been measured; inspect the affected request identifiers before rollout.
investigation_summary: Repeated submissions create duplicate records in the dated test database. The replay path inserts before checking for an existing request. The evidence supports a procedure change; current production impact remains unmeasured.
